single_rule: Classifier top-1 on the entire original portrait; no detector fallback
multi_rule: Original YOLO predict; additional class-agnostic NMS by YOLO confidence; classify retained crops; on disagreement use classifier at confidence >= 0.9, otherwise use YOLO identity

validation_evidence.selection_metric: Highest fixed-threshold micro identity F1 among eight recorded exploratory validation candidates

limitations: Validation tuning is exploratory; final test is required for generalization claims.
Classifier confidence is uncalibrated and is not compared with YOLO confidence.
Post-NMS may suppress overlapping different people on natural photographs; validation images are synthetic.
Single-image inputs use explicit single mode; multi-image inputs use explicit multi mode.
